entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This appeal is filed by the State with a delay of 247 days.

As per the dictum laid down by the Division Bench of this Court in the case of State of Kerala and another vs. Kool Foam Pvt. Ltd. and another (L.A.A No. 15 of 2024), the delay of more than 120 days will be hit by the embargo in section 74 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: State of Kerala and another vs. Kool Foam Pvt. Ltd. and another (L.A.A No. 15 of 2024)

sentences.text: Hence the delay condonation petition (C.M.Appln.No.1 of 2024) seeking to condone the delay of 247 days is legally unsustainable and it is dismissed.
Consequently, the L.A.Appeal is also dismissed.
